summary: Someone at home brings up news because it affects a person or concern the household recognizes.
realLife: During the 2017 Senate health care debate, a New Jersey mother shared her son’s hospital bill to explain what lifetime insurance limits could mean for his care. His condition kept the family from attending large protests.
inGame: needs: a household-to-story relevance read for the opening news exchange.
gates: A connection between this household and the story is recorded.

turns.what: The family returns to the story when a letter confirms which household member it affects.
turns.pulledBy: The broadcast gave no effective date and the letter supplies one.
turns.writesBack: The later conversation refers to both the news and the notice.

turns.what: A parent brings the hospital statement to the kitchen table and asks whether the proposal would change the child’s existing coverage.
turns.pulledBy: The household has the statement and its insurance policy, while the legislation is still pending.
turns.writesBack: The family writes down the coverage question for the district office and keeps the existing bill amount on record.
